gaps.detail: langgraph-checkpoint-postgres is not formally declared/frozen for agent-runtime, so the production AsyncPostgresSaver path is fail-closed and not claimed deployable yet.
asyncpg is lazy-loaded by PostgresRunControlStore but is not formally declared/frozen in apps/agent-runtime; workflow uses a test-only overlay.
API AgentRunControlService is a fail-closed dependency seam; production composition of graph registry, checkpointer, store, authorizers and service lifecycle is not yet installed.
Control plane requires OperationGuard, but the production NODE-20 PostgreSQL idempotency adapter is not yet composed into agent-runtime.
ResumeAuthorizer contract exists, but production approval identity/token/version policy binding is not yet composed.
ExternalJobPort supports checkpoint-and-wake semantics, but the production job.completed event to deterministic LangGraph resume adapter is not yet composed.
Safe event contracts exist, but durable realtime transport, LangSmith trace correlation, dashboards and alerts are not yet production-composed.
Hosted GitHub Actions cannot allocate a runner because of the repository account payment/spending-limit condition; no hosted PASS may be claimed.
